Method of Attack: Ransomware as a Service (RaaS) distributing ransomware that encrypts files using RSA-1024 encryption
Ransomware relaunches itself to gain administrative privileges
Drops ransom notes with affiliate email and payment instructions
Sets desktop wallpaper to ransom image
Writes RSA key encrypted by master key to a file for later extraction after ransom payment
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with Remote Desktop services potentially hacked

Indicators of Compromise.Ransom note text: Contains email info@decrypt.ws and bitcoin payment instructions
